title: The Handling-Machine
question: Today, can unnamed_first_person_narrator discover what directs the Martians?
light: violet lightning from the west, black shadows
palette: yellow clay, grey plaster, green vapour
look: Square ruin, readable faces, widening pit

scullery_wake.described: A buried Victorian scullery occupies the west half of a ruined villa back wing. Grey York stone flags run from the kitchen doorway on the east wall to two plank doors on the south wall. A shallow brown stone sink sits beneath the earth-packed north window, with a black cast-iron rain-water pump at its right hand. A brick copper with a round wooden lid fills the north-west corner beside split firewood. A deal cupboard stands south of the copper. Limewashed brick walls carry cracks, dust and fallen plaster. A meat chopper hangs beside the kitchen doorway. Grey daylight falls in from the east kitchen doorway across the flags. The ceiling is buried beneath rubble, and the air carries the vibration of machinery outside. Broken crockery spreads across the central route, while the doorway gives the only clear light.
scullery_wake.route: from the kitchen doorway across the stone flags to the copper
scullery_wake.geometry: The kitchen doorway fills the RIGHT edge at medium size. The pump stands at the LEFT edge at medium size, with the sink behind it. The copper occupies the far LEFT corner at medium size. The south plank doors fill the far wall between the copper and doorway. Broken crockery scatters across the foreground CENTER from the lower LEFT edge to the lower RIGHT edge. Fallen plaster lies beneath the doorway. The blocked north window sits above the sink at the upper LEFT edge. The cupboard occupies the rear LEFT wall beside the copper. The open route crosses the CENTER from the RIGHT doorway toward the far LEFT copper. Grey daylight enters from the RIGHT edge and falls across the flags.
scullery_wake.crowd: 1 background person crouches beyond the kitchen doorway; plaster dust falls across the flags.
scullery_wake.ambience: deep thudding vibration, crockery tremors, distant engine-like machinery

pit_peephole.described: A ruined kitchen opening hangs above the northern rim of the great circular pit. A triangular aperture cuts the south wall between a fallen beam and broken bricks. Green vapour crosses the view in bright veils. The far rim carries smashed shrubbery and a tall fighting-machine against the evening sky. The buried scullery lies behind the camera, with broken crockery and plaster underfoot. A vertical slit opens beside the triangular hole, and a rubble slope descends from the opening toward the pit. The north rubble mound frames the lower edge, while the far blue sky fills the upper edge. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.
pit_peephole.route: from the triangular aperture across the rubble edge toward the opened cylinder
pit_peephole.geometry: The triangular aperture fills the foreground CENTER at medium size. The green vapour crosses the middle distance from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge. The fighting-machine stands at the far RIGHT edge against the sky. The rubble mound rises along the LEFT edge. The terraced pit wall descends across the lower frame. The far shrubbery forms a dark band beneath the upper sky edge. The vertical slit occupies the RIGHT foreground. The south sky light catches the beam, vapour and far rim.
pit_peephole.crowd: 1 distant Martian fighting-machine works beside the opened cylinder; green vapour drifts across the pit.
pit_peephole.ambience: heavy beating thud, wind over rubble, distant metallic handling

slit_interior.described: The inside face of the ruined kitchen wall frames the pit through a triangular aperture. A broken beam crosses the upper edge, and loose brickwork forms the lower edge. Rubble slopes away from the opening toward the central excavation. The far shrubbery is crushed into a low dark band. The evening sky occupies the upper distance, while green vapour makes a luminous veil between the opening and the pit floor. Fallen plaster and crockery lie at the base of the wall. The north wall remains close behind the camera, and the far rim spans the upper edge. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.

The fighting-machine rises at the far LEFT edge. Green vapour occupies the middle distance between the CENTER and the upper edge. The rubble slope fills the lower frame from LEFT to RIGHT. The south sky light outlines the beam and the far rim. Loose crockery marks the lower RIGHT foreground.

slit_interior.ambience: thudding machinery, metallic handling, wind through smashed shrubbery

pit_work.described: Yellow clay, gravel and splashed garden mould form successive banks around the excavation. A mound of bluish-grey powder sits in the south-east corner, and bright aluminium bars rest in the south-west corner. The far rim carries smashed shrubbery beneath a warm blue sky. The northern rubble mound rises behind the aperture, with broken beams and plaster marking the buried house. Green vapour threads across the working ground. Evening sky light enters from the WEST and falls across the eastern terrace, the machinery and the vapour. The digging-machine follows the eastern route around the rim, while the far fighting-machine marks the upper edge. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.

pit_work.geometry: The eastern shelf runs from the RIGHT foreground to the far RIGHT edge. The powder mound occupies the far LEFT corner at medium size, with aluminium bars beyond it. The north rubble wall fills the background from LEFT to RIGHT. The fighting-machine stands on the far rim at small size near the upper CENTER. The green vapour crosses the central ground. The west sky light catches the shelf and terrace edges. The digging-machine follows the EAST route around the rim.
pit_work.ambience: beating machinery, piping metal, wind over the open excavation

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: After eating, I woke to the thudding room and found the scullery open around me.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The curate had gone to the kitchen doorway, where the triangular opening faced the Martians.

lines.speaker: curate
lines.text: Give me the slit; I will watch while you listen.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I found him watching through the wall, his shoulders hunched and his head hidden beyond the gap.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The room carried an engine-like clatter, while gold touched a tree beyond the opening.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I kept close; the opening showed the Martians.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I crossed the floor on my knees, placing each boot among the broken crockery.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: My fingers found his leg; his whole body sprang, and plaster thundered outside.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I held his arm until the fallen dust settled, and we crouched together.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Through the fresh slit, I saw the roadway transformed into a circular excavation.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The house had burst into rubble, while the fifth cylinder lay beneath the old foundations.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Green vapour crossed the opening, and a deserted fighting-machine watched from the far rim.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The glittering workman drew rods and plates from the cylinder with three reaching tentacles.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Then I studied the Martians: round bodies, immense eyes, beaks, ears, and clustered hands.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Their bodies suggested thought, touch, blood, and perpetual exertion; I doubted every human account of their signals.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: He took the opening, and I listened to the machinery hidden beyond the wall.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: When I looked again, the handling-machine shaped its parts; a smaller digger traced the rim.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The machine worked without a visible Martian directing it.

lines.speaker: curate
lines.text: The work goes on without a master.
